absent.note: a retention policy was changed, not an access policy

annotations.rationale: A negative control about missing recordings after a shortened retention policy. A policy was changed shortly before the problem, but it is a retention policy and nothing is said about signing in, so the reported change is not an access-policy change and no signal is stated. The customer even says that everybody can still sign in. The engineer explains the cause and the restore path; none of it is a diagnostic action of the pack.
